=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/alert_triage.py:685-691 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In decide_group(), the host's `pipeline_blocked` override (alert from a pipeline_self_files workflow, `files` intersecting pipeline_self_files, or a stalled `ai:alert-triage` heal issue) runs only when the model returns `healable` or `pipeline_blocked`, so a `noise` or `environmental` verdict routes the group to `done` with no escalation or self-fix dispatch.
  WHY: The plan (docs/plans/alert-triage-auto-heal-plan.md:308-318) and the linked issue say the host, not the model, decides pipeline_blocked, and alert text is untrusted and can steer the model; all four flagging reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly disagreed and called it a deliberate, conservative design choice, citing the test_decide_rows fixture, the agents.d fragment and the plan's routing table at lines 320-328.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
(No task gaps reported.)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
(No findings reported.)
- Did not adopt luna's pass-1 finding on the `decide_group()` noise/environmental override: that code was not touched by the last run, and the behavior is deliberate (fixture `("noise", {"from_self_workflow": True}, [], ("noise", "done", "noise"))`, the agents.d fragment, and the plan's routing table at docs/plans/alert-triage-auto-heal-plan.md lines 320-328).
- HARDENING (not a finding): scripts/alert_triage.py and scripts/alert_triage_route.sh | the `result` dict in `prepare()` and `at_prepare()` after the `_at_log "prepare ..."` line
  ISSUE: When list calls keep failing, every group is deferred every hour, nothing is escalated, and the only trace is a `route=deferred reason=tracking_unavailable` log line.
  FIX: Add `"lists_ok": lists_ok` to the result and emit `::warning::` when it is false. Estimated 3-4 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/alert_triage.py:decide_group() lines 685-691 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The host's pipeline_blocked override runs only if the model classifies the group as `healable` or `pipeline_blocked`.
  WHY: If the model misclassifies the group as `noise` or `environmental`, the host override is bypassed and the group is marked `done` and suppressed, which violates the rule that the host decides pipeline_blocked.
- HARDENING (not a finding): scripts/alert_triage_route.sh | at_prepare() after the logging line
  ISSUE: When list calls fail repeatedly, all groups are deferred every hour with no prominent trace for an operator.
  FIX: Check `lists_ok` and emit `::warning::`. Estimated 3-4 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

- scripts/alert_triage.py:lines 685-691 (the `if classification in ("healable", "pipeline_blocked")` guard around `host_blocked`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The host's `pipeline_blocked` override is skipped when the model returns `noise` or `environmental`, so a group the plan says is pipeline_blocked is silently routed to `done`.
  WHY: A real failure in a pipeline_self_files entry that the model misclassifies is dropped without escalation, which contradicts `docs/plans/alert-triage-auto-heal-plan.md:308-318`. The `tests/test_alert_triage.py::test_decide_rows` noise row enshrines the deviation. Suggested fix: lift `host_blocked` outside the guard and update the test.
- HARDENING (not a finding): scripts/alert_triage_route.sh | at_prepare(), after the `prepare …` summary line is logged
  ISSUE: When list calls keep failing, every group is deferred every hour and nobody is told.
  FIX: Include `lists_ok` in the summary and emit `::warning::` when it is false. Estimated 3-4 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/alert_triage.py:decide_group() lines 686-691 (with prepare() line 470 setting from_self_workflow, and apply() lines 795-807 writing done markers) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A `noise` or `environmental` verdict falls through to `decision.update(route="done", ...)` even when `group["from_self_workflow"]` is true or the diagnosis `files` intersect pipeline_self_files, so the group gets a done marker and a ledger occurrence with no escalation or self-fix dispatch.
  WHY: The linked issue says the host, not the model, decides pipeline_blocked, and a hostile log line in untrusted alert text can steer the model to `noise`. The done marker is committed (apply() line 799) and the failure is silently dropped. test_decide_rows encodes this row. Suggested fix: apply the host_blocked re-check to noise/environmental.
- HARDENING (not a finding): scripts/alert_triage.py | prepare(), after the result dict is built (around line 475); surfaced via at_prepare() in scripts/alert_triage_route.sh lines 163-177
  ISSUE: When list calls keep failing, every group is deferred every hour, nobody is told, and newer records never enter the 30-record window.
  FIX: Include `lists_ok` in the summary and emit `::warning::` when it is false. Estimated 3-4 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
